name: Q Etchant II
description: Q Etchant II is a specialized wet etching solution based on phosphoric acid and ammonium fluoride designed for selective silicon nitride and silicon oxynitride etching in semiconductor manufacturing. The phosphoric acid component provides the primary etch chemistry for silicon nitride at elevated temperatures, while ammonium fluoride modifies the etch selectivity and rate. This formulation offers excellent selectivity between silicon nitride and silicon dioxide, making it essential for processes requiring precise nitride removal without oxide loss. Q Etchant II is used in LOCOS isolation, spacer patterning, and various integration schemes in CMOS device fabrication.
physicalProperties: Appearance: clear liquid; Density: ~1.4 g/cm³; pH: <2; Boiling Point: ~140-160 °C (varies by formulation)
